snippet.title: Portabellows - Gameplay Teaser
snippet.description:
First focused look at the exploration and collection gameplay of our game Portabellows!
👉 Wishlist at https://store.steampowered.com/app/2339000/Portabellows/

We've been inspired by n64 days, Banjo-Tooie, Super Mario 64, and Donkey Kong 64 ❤️ and have been working on our game for a while, super happy to share more of its positive vibe!

Thanks for watching :)

🎵 Music created by us: Nance & Phred
